scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm run lint:root && pnpm run lint:scripts && pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:boundaries
scripts.lint:scripts: uv run --project apps/server ruff check scripts && uv run --project apps/server ruff format --check scripts
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test:unit: turbo run test:unit && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: uv run --project apps/server pytest -c apps/server/pyproject.toml --rootdir . scripts/tests
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/server ruff format apps/server scripts
scripts.check:boundaries: uv run --project apps/server python scripts/check_module_boundaries.py && pnpm --filter @motionile/server run lint:imports
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run contract:check && pnpm run evals
